title: Amazing Animals: Wild and Weird
description: Discover the most incredible, strange, and awesome animals on our planet!

questions.q: Which animal can run faster than a car on the highway?
questions.hint: This spotted cat can reach 70 mph - faster than most cars in the city!

questions.q: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.hint: It's more than humans have, but less than five!
There's a saying about these big gray animals having amazing memories!

questions.q: What's the loudest animal on Earth?
questions.hint: This ocean giant's call can be heard from hundreds of miles away!

questions.q: Which animal can change its color to match its surroundings?
questions.hint: This lizard is like a living invisibility cloak!
